::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 17th [1884-1893]  
**Manuscript:** MS Winchester City Council, Historic Resources Centre LH 3803.3
:::

Dear Madam

I am afraid these papers will not quite suit the [Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd).

Would not [Friendly Leaves](organizations/other_71.qmd) be a good field for them[^1]

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: *Friendly Leaves* (1876-1917) was the magazine of the Girls’ Friendly Society, and continued as *The Girls’ Friendly Society Magazine* to 1951.
